pin_check_evidence.note: Code always re-runs pin check per genome (never publishes pin_checks). Evidence only: compare pin_check_s presence and SHIP across genomes.
pin_check_evidence.argument_for_sharing: On W5x pin_check is 151.8 s; if conclusion is identical for the same (binary, argv, release) and only depends on help-derived pin template + size members already confirmed, sharing would cut rho(20) toward 1.29.
pin_check_evidence.argument_against_sharing: Pin check samples this genome's records and compares whole vs pinned body bytes; empty or sparse samples, different hit sets, or layout width can flip ok. Design table already marks pin_checks as cross-genome-unsafe without re-check.
